lines.zh: 我拖着步子走过来，关节一格一格响。
lines.en: I shuffle over, joints clicking step by step.

lines.zh: 我的塑料壳在灯下反光。
lines.en: My plastic shell glints under the light.
I tilt my head and inch forward.

lines.zh: 脚下的地板被我压得吱呀。
lines.en: The floor creaks under me.
I wander the hallway.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀道具在背上晃。
lines.en: The prop wings sway on my back.
I stop dead in the middle of a step.

lines.zh: 我的影子被灯拉得很长。
lines.en: The lamp stretches my shadow long.
I turn toward the noise.
I stand while my head turns slowly.
I am looking, but I do not move.
My jaw hangs half open.
I hold still like a display piece.
The light flickers across my face.
I wait for someone to come close.
I lower my chin.

lines.zh: 灯亮着，我就在这儿看着你。
lines.en: The lights are on, and I'm watching you from here.
I turn my head and look straight at you.
You are standing still; good.
My eyes are very white.

lines.zh: 你身上有股旧塑料味吗？
lines.en: Do you smell of old plastic?
I do not start things, but I remember.
My orange beak points right at you.
You are taller than I expected.
I open my mouth and no sound comes.
Lower your hands.

lines.zh: 我们这样对看，也不算友好。
lines.en: Staring like this is not friendly either.
Another mark on my shell.
I barely move back.
This body does not feel much.
My head is badly askew.

lines.zh: 我晃了晃脑袋，嘎吱作响。
lines.en: I shake my head, creaking.

lines.zh: 南瓜色的我，笑起来很亮。
lines.en: Pumpkin-colored, my grin glows.
The joints click louder.
I look at you.
I will remember.
I will not eat.
I am only plastic and metal.
The wrapper crinkles; I tilt my head.
You hold out candy. I don't eat.

lines.zh: 我的颚合不上，吃不进去。
lines.en: My jaw will not close enough to eat.
I'm not hungry; I just like watching you hold it.
I reach out and swat it.
I prefer something else.

lines.zh: 我被撞得退了一步，关节响。
lines.en: The bump knocks me back a step, joints clacking.
You hit me like a cabinet.
I am not easy to knock over.
My shell scrapes your shoulder.
My plastic shell didn't dent at all.
You fall back; I am still here.
The blow turns my head.
I set my head straight again.
The floor complains under us.
Do not stand in the middle of the hall.

lines.zh: 这栋楼里还有别的玩偶。
lines.en: There are other animatronics in this building.
We only pass each other in the halls.
I do not say much.

lines.zh: 我站在她旁边，看了很久。
lines.en: I stand beside her and look for a long time.
The light jumps between us.
We turn our heads together.
No music, nothing at all.
The floor remembers two sets of steps.
The door closes behind us.
I bend and a joint catches.
I pick up what fell.
I hold it and the plastic creaks.
I look, then pocket it.
This is quite heavy.
I hold it with three fingers.

lines.zh: 举到眼前，看看还亮不亮。
lines.en: Held up to the eye, is it still lit?
Left here, someone would step on it.
I set it on the shelf.
I am not good at holding things.
You struck me.
Then we have begun.

lines.zh: 南瓜灯里的火晃了一下。
lines.en: The flame inside my pumpkin head flickers.
There is nothing else in my eyes.
I remember where you are.
My plastic beak opens with a click.
I do not shout and I do not run.

lines.zh: 我的关节一格一格转过来。
lines.en: My joints turn notch by notch.
This will be returned.
Come; do not just stand there.
I have closed that door many times.
My head tilts again.
Do not look back.
I follow, one step at a time.
The floor never stops creaking.
My arm is very long.

lines.zh: 我停下来，是为了让你以为我停了。
lines.en: I stopped so you would think I stopped.
The light goes out for a moment.
The fire in my pumpkin flickers.
I am behind that door.
I turn the corner.
You took the wrong way.

lines.zh: 我不用快，我只要一直走。
lines.en: I need not be fast; I only keep walking.
Only the two of us on this floor.
The Halloween lights are on me.
Do you hear music? No.
I put my hand on the door.
Hold still; I am almost there.

lines.zh: 我的头在门上撞了一下。
lines.en: My head knocks the door.
I will remember this door.
There is no second exit in this hall.

lines.zh: 二十七点一击，外壳都凹进去。
lines.en: Twenty-seven a blow, and my casing dents.
My arm swings around.
My jaw bites your shoulder.

lines.zh: 这一下很重，我几乎不后退。
lines.en: That was heavy; I barely recoil.
My hand catches your collar.

lines.zh: 我的金属手指嵌进你的皮甲。
lines.en: My metal fingers dig into your leather.
I pin you against the door.

lines.zh: 你挡了第一下，没挡第二下。
lines.en: You blocked the first, not the second.
After the blow, my head turns back to you.
My joints are clicking.
I do not tire.
Can you still stand?

lines.zh: 我的塑料壳上有一道划痕。
lines.en: There is a scratch on my plastic shell.
That one returns the favor.

lines.zh: 南瓜灯的火，从我眼里漏出来。
lines.en: Jack-o'-lantern fire leaks from my eyes.
Almost.

lines.zh: 你听，骨头在响，南瓜灯也灭了。
lines.en: Listen, bones rattle and the jack-o-lantern died.
I let go and you slide down.

lines.zh: 灯光亮起，我站在舞台边。
lines.en: The lights come up and I stand by the stage.
I come out from behind the curtain.
There is no one else in this building.

lines.zh: 我的脚第一次踩到这块地板。
lines.en: My feet touch this floor for the first time.
The light flickers, and there I am.

lines.zh: 我的南瓜壳里点着蜡烛。
lines.en: A candle burns inside my pumpkin shell.
The curtain brushes against me.
The door closes behind me.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀道具晃了一下。
lines.en: The prop wings sway once.
The game has started.
I stand and wait for you to turn.
The music plays once and stops.
Fire softens my plastic shell.

lines.zh: 我摔下楼梯，一路响到底。
lines.en: I fall down the stairs, clattering all the way.
Water floods my joints.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，壳凹了一块。
lines.en: The blast flips me and dents my shell.

lines.zh: 一阵光打过来，我的眼睛闪了闪。
lines.en: A flash of magic makes my eyes flicker.

lines.zh: 我不会饿，可我的电快没了。
lines.en: I cannot starve, but my power is failing.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我的动作乱了一拍。
lines.en: Lightning hits and my movements jolt.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，零件在黑暗里散开。
lines.en: I fall, and my parts scatter in the dark.
